name: Palo Brunch Warm Pastry Basket (Mini Cinnamon Rolls, Croissants & Pain au Chocolat)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
whyItWorks: Brought warm to your table at the start of Palo Brunch: soft glazed mini cinnamon rolls, flaky butter croissants, and pain au chocolat made from refined white flour.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy the warm glazed cinnamon roll, plain butter croissant, or chocolate croissant; skip the seeded multigrain bread sticks (grissini) and any almond/nut-crusted Danish.
watchOuts: Skip seeded breadsticks in the same basket
